GHGSAT-D


GHGSAT-D is no longer on orbit


NORAD ID: 41602
Int'l Code: 2016-040D
Launch date: June 22, 2016
Source: Canada (CA)
Launch site: SRIHARIKOTA (SRI)
Decay date: 2024-12-11

GHGSat-D (nicknamed Claire) is a demonstration satellite for GHGSat Inc, a Montreal company which hopes to field a fleet of small spacecraft to monitor greenhouse gas output, supplying data to corporate customers who want to manage their emission rates. The satellite is about the size of a microwave oven.
